# Vendored terminal renderer

- `xterm.js`, `xterm.css`: npm `@xterm/xterm@6.0.0`, https://github.com/xtermjs/xterm.js — MIT, see `xterm.LICENSE`.
- `xterm-addon-fit.js`: npm `@xterm/addon-fit@0.11.0`, same upstream — MIT, see `xterm-addon-fit.LICENSE`.

Downloaded using `npm pack --ignore-scripts`; runtime files are copied without modification. No clipboard, external-link-opening or WebGL addon is enabled.
